callees.name: _is_under_submodules
callees.pre_condition: sf is a normalized forward-slash file path string relative to proj_dir; submodules is a non-empty sequence of subdirectory paths
callees.post_condition: Returns True if and only if the path sf starts with a prefix equal to one of the submodule directory paths, where matching respects directory boundaries (concatenating the submodule path with a path separator before comparison)

callees.name: _collect_project_source_files
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing directory path; submodules, if not None, is a non-empty sequence of subdirectory paths relative to proj_dir
callees.post_condition: Returns a set of normalized forward-slash relative file paths for all project source files discovered under proj_dir. When submodules is not None, the returned set is restricted to files whose paths fall under at least one of the specified submodule directories.
